title: 在函数中使用多个参数

resolved.title: 使用多个参数

content.text: 你可以通过**逗号**分隔来为一个函数定义多个参数。
content.text_html:
You can define multiple parameters for a function by comma-separating them.

你可以通过**逗号分隔来为一个函数定义多个参数。

content.text: 上面的例子定义了函数 **myFunc** 要接受两个参数 x 和 y。
content.text_html:
The example above defines the function **myFunc **to take two parameters.

上面的例子定义了函数**myFunc **要接受两个参数。

resolved.question_text: 用什么字符来分隔参数？
resolved.question_text_html: What character is used to separate parameters from each other?

resolved.title: 使用多个参数

content.text: 参数是在函数的定义中使用的。
content.text_html:
The parameters are used within the function's definition.

参数是在函数的定义中使用的。

resolved.title: 使用多个参数

content.text: 在调用该函数时，必须按照你定义的顺序提供参数。
content.text_html:
When calling the function, provide the arguments in the same order in which you defined them.

在调用该函数时，按照你定义的顺序提供参数。

content.text: 所有的参数将被赋值到一个 arguments 数组中。你可以通过这样来按顺序获取每一个参数：arguments[0], arguments[1]
content.text_html:
If you pass more arguments than are defined, they will be assigned to an array called arguments. They can be used like this: arguments[0], arguments[1], etc.

如果你传递的参数多于定义的参数，它们将被分配到一个叫做arguments的数组中。它们可以像这样使用：arguments[0], arguments[1], 等等。

content.name: 谁赢了比赛
content.description: 根据球队1和球队2的得分，输出谁赢了比赛
content.title: 谁赢了比赛

resolved.title: 谁赢了比赛
resolved.problem_statement_md:
给定的程序，输入两支球队的得分。

请完善函数`finalResult`，将球队1和球队2的得分作为参数，并输出比赛的最终结果。

- **"Team 1 won"**：如果球队1的得分高于球队2的得分
- **"Team 2 won"**：如果球队2的得分高于球队1的得分。
- **"Draw"**：如果两支球队得分。
resolved.problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Multiple Parameters[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

You are given a program that takes Team 1 and Team 2 football teams goals as inputs accordingly.
Complete the function to take Team 1 and Team 2 goals [b]as arguments[/b] and output the final result of the match:
- [b]"Team 1 won"[/b], if Team 1's score is higher than Team 2's score
- [b]"Team 2 won"[/b], if Team 2's score is higher than Team 1's score
- [b]"Draw"[/b], if the scores are equal

[b]Sample Input[/b]
3
4

[b]Sample Output[/b]
Team 2 won

[note]The function call is already given.
[/note]
resolved.hint_md: 函数调用已经给出，仅需完善函数`finalResult()`即可。

resolved.title: 使用多个参数
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Multiple Parameters[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

After defining the function, you can call it as many times as needed. 
JavaScript functions do not check the number of arguments received.
[note]If a function is called with missing arguments (fewer than declared), the missing values are set to [b]undefined[/b], which[b] [/b]indicates that a variable has not been assigned a value.[/note]
resolved.description_en:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Multiple Parameters[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

After defining the function, you can call it as many times as needed. 
JavaScript functions do not check the number of arguments received.
[note]If a function is called with missing arguments (fewer than declared), the missing values are set to [b]undefined[/b], which[b] [/b]indicates that a variable has not been assigned a value.[/note]

content.text:
在定义了函数之后，你可以根据需要多次调用它。
JavaScript 函数不检查收到的参数数量。
content.text_html:
After defining the function, you can call it as many times as needed. JavaScript functions do not check the number of arguments received.

在定义了函数之后，你可以根据需要多次调用它。 JavaScript函数不检查收到的参数数量。

content.text: 如果一个函数在调用时有缺失的参数（少于声明的参数），缺失的值会被设置为**undefined**，这表示一个变量没有被赋值。
content.text_html:
If a function is called with missing arguments (fewer than declared), the missing values are set to undefined, which** **indicates that a variable has not been assigned a value.

如果一个函数在调用时有缺失的参数（少于声明的参数），缺失的值会被设置为未定义，这**表示一个变量没有被赋值。
